summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K by Enigmatig Limited, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, furnishing its interim report for the six months ended March 31, 2026. It includes financial statements and is intended for incorporation by reference into future Form F-3 registrations. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, or management changes. The filing is purely a periodic financial disclosure, so it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
